hint.assistant: Its name, how it addresses you and how it talks — on the web, in the app and on calls.
hint.tools: Which actions may run without confirmation.
hint.browser: Choose which browser the agent uses to open web pages.
hint.publish: Choose how finished videos are posted to Douyin.
hint.appearance: Language, theme, color mode, type size and the workbench.
hint.voice: Your call model, voice and habits. Model and voice changes apply to your next call.

team.acceptHint: Accept this invitation to join the workspace.
team.accepted: Invitation accepted. The workspace is now selected.

tools.permissionNote: Tool permissions are confirmed per action in chat; enforcement happens on the backend.

desc.auto: Prefer your own browser through the extension, and fall back to the cloud browser when it isn't connected. Not available on phones.
desc.local: Always use Chrome on the cloud desktop — no extension needed; site logins live on the cloud desktop.
desc.remote: Use Chrome on your own computer through the extension, with your logins; keep the extension connected.

browser.fallbackHint: The extension isn't connected yet — the cloud browser will be used until it connects.

desc.desktop: Post straight from the Douyin creator centre signed in on the cloud desktop: the agent fills the form, uploads and clicks publish — no authorization needed. Keep the creator-centre login alive in the authorization centre.
desc.api: Post through the Douyin Open Platform: the agent prepares the video and shows a QR code; you scan it with the Douyin app and tap publish there. Requires binding a Douyin account in the authorization centre first.

publish.followingDefault: No choice yet — following the deployment default: {{route}}
publish.note: Scheduled tasks and templates follow this setting too. If an account's auto publish is switched off by risk control, the QR route is used for the time being and the chat says why.

appearance.developerModeHint: Adds the review, terminal, browser and files tabs to the workbench; off, it shows only the cloud desktop.

notifications.title: System notifications
notifications.description: Receive task results and requests only while locked, in the background, or offline. All foreground pages, temporary focus loss and brief connection loss stay quiet. Signing in on another phone moves notifications to it.

status.denied: Notifications are blocked in system settings

notifications.localBody: This notification checks display on this phone.
notifications.unavailable: The task linked to this notification is no longer available.
notifications.setupFailed: Notifications are not connected. Please retry.

result.local: Local test scheduled. Lock or background the app within 10 seconds and keep its process running. Staying in the foreground suppresses it.
result.accepted: The push service accepted the test. Check your system notifications.
result.failed: The test notification failed. Please retry.
result.cancelled: The app returned to the foreground, or your login or notification binding changed. The notification was cancelled.
result.unbound: This phone is not registered for notifications.
result.pending: Server test scheduled. Lock or background the app within 10 seconds. Staying in or returning to the foreground suppresses it.

voice.previewFailed: The preview didn't play. Try again in a moment.
voice.saved: Switched to {{name}}. Your next call uses it.
voice.loadFailed: Couldn't load the voices. Refresh and try again.

call.title: Call habits
call.recap: Mention last call when it picks up
call.recapHint: Off: it just says hello and leaves earlier calls alone.
call.reports: Tell me about finished work during a call
call.reportsHint: Off: only what you asked for on this call is told; other results stay in the chat.
call.saved: Saved. A call in progress uses it right away.

voice.note: Every voice speaks both Chinese and English; the English ones suit English conversations best. A call in progress keeps its voice.

model.title: Voice model
model.hint: Each model has its own voices and remembers your choice. Model and voice changes apply to your next call.
model.saved: Voice model switched. Your next call uses it.

assistant.placeholder: e.g. Mary (leave empty for the default “Personal assistant”)
assistant.addressPlaceholder: e.g. Andrew (leave empty for no name)
assistant.emojiHint: Adds an emoji to a reply once in a while; off means none.
assistant.personaPlaceholder: e.g. talk like an old friend; flag the risks before anything that costs money
assistant.personaHint: Changes only how it talks, never what it may do or its rules.
assistant.saved: Saved. The web, the app and calls use it right away.
assistant.invalid: The name and what it calls you are one line of up to 20 characters; the description up to 300.
assistant.note: You can also just say “call yourself Mary from now on” or “call me Andrew” in chat or on a call; it changes this itself.
assistant.restartIntro: Get to know each other again
assistant.restartIntroHint: Go through the first-meeting questions again; your current settings come up as the defaults.

learned.title: What it has learned about you
learned.hint: From what you said and the reasons you picked with a thumbs-down. It follows these; remove any that are wrong.
learned.empty: Nothing yet. Say things like “too long” or “just the conclusion” in chat, or pick a reason with a thumbs-down, and it will remember.
learned.removed: Removed. It won't follow that any more.
learned.removeFailed: Couldn't remove it. Please try again.
learned.reactions: Reasons picked with thumbs-downs in the last 30 days
